title: Thornwood Vigil
message:
Thornwood Vigil: an original night-forest loop in the manner of David Whittaker
(Shadow of the Beast). E minor, speed 5, intro / A / B / A'. No drums; vibrato from the
first tick; per-tick decays; an echo channel in B. Sound library presets only.
Source: songs/amiga_thornwood_vigil.gen.js. Rendered and measured, not listened to.
